title: Is Old Faithful Really as Punctual as a Clock?
description: Old Faithful is famous for its eruptions, but its timing has a little wiggle room.
narration: Is Old Faithful really as punctual as a clock? Not quite, because its wait can run a bit early or late. Underground, tight spots in a geyser's plumbing let pressure build up until it bursts out. Rangers say the next wait depends on the eruption before it. A short eruption is followed by a shorter wait than a long one. Even careful forecasts come with a little wiggle room.
